d6: Archived values can differ from the values published at the issue time.
d7: FIRMS is the MODIS standard-product archive, not the near-real-time product. When each value was available at issue time is not known.
d8: ERA5 is retrospective reanalysis. M5 used it only for association in hindsight.
d9: HLS has 2.7% clear land on both pilot dates. SMAP has no recommended-quality retrieval in the study box. M5 gated out both.
d10: 2019 is the test season of both Stage T and M5-C. It was reused and is not an independent test. M5-C holds one 2019 episode.

d11: Correction: M5 later replaced its issue_time_valid label (m5-evidence-5). No M5 source has a verified publication time per observation. NEA and IMERG Early availability is a nominal latency assumption, not verified.
